mechanism.claim: After a completed four-hour BTC range, a two-hour auction strictly contained inside that range represents temporary balance. If the final two-hour auction then closes beyond exactly one prior boundary with an agreeing body, the balance has resolved into directional price discovery. Follow that resolution for eight hours during elevated realized variation.
mechanism.side: long for upper-boundary resolution and short for lower-boundary resolution
mechanism.why_distinct: Break-retest acceptance requires a boundary break followed by a later retest; engulfing acceptance sweeps both prior boundaries; chop resolution uses path efficiency and a late escape; Donchian uses a rolling terminal boundary. HVIARR requires a disjoint strict inside auction followed by a separate two-hour outside acceptance, with no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, fitted outcome, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the full completed eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily containment-to-resolution clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.prior_range: first 240 one-minute rows [D-8h,D-4h), high=max high and low=min low
features.inside_auction: next 120 rows [D-4h,D-2h), requiring high<prior high and low>prior low
features.long_resolution: release close>prior high and release close>release open
features.short_resolution: release close<prior low and release close<release open
features.ambiguity: exactly one resolution side must hold
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns across [D-8h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: strict inside auction, one accepted release direction, and variation gate pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: strict disjoint containment followed by separate outside terminal acceptance

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no range, containment, release, body, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
